essential_services.petrol_pumps: HPCL and IndianOil retail outlets are available along the main entrance road and Kothagudem bypass (~1–2 km from the temple).
essential_services.ev_charging_stations: IndianOil EV Charging Point: Located on the Kothagudem-Bhadrachalam Road in Palvoncha (~30 km away). Public charging points in the town center are limited.
essential_services.public_toilets: Located near the main temple entry gates, Kalyana Katta, and the town bus stand.
essential_services.drinking_water_facilities: Purified RO drinking water outlets are placed along the queue complexes.
essential_services.parking_areas: Designated open parking lots are maintained near the temple entrance and town bus stand.
